🌎 BEYOND THE 956

American professional basketball player Greene Da'monte Khiree, 28, was arrested in Nigeria after authorities allegedly found 75 pounds of cannabis inside two suitcases bearing his name at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos, Nigeria's National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) said.

Khiree, a native of Savannah, Georgia, arrived in Lagos on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an Emirates flight from Thailand via Dubai, the agency said. Officers acting on credible intelligence had him under surveillance and watched him allegedly abandon his two checked-in suitcases and try to leave the airport with only his carry-on luggage. They arrested him in the airport car park.

A search of the two bags, both bearing his name tags, allegedly turned up 32 parcels of “Loud,” a potent strain of cannabis, weighing 33.95 kilograms — about 75 pounds. A tracking device was also recovered from the luggage, the agency said.

Khiree told investigators he had been living and playing professional basketball in Thailand since October 2025 and had come to Nigeria on holiday to build contacts that could advance his basketball career, according to the NDLEA. The agency said a forensic examination of his mobile phone pointed to his knowledge of and involvement in the alleged drug trafficking operation.

The NDLEA announced the arrest on Sunday, November 15. As of Monday, November 16, no charges or court date had been reported, and the investigation remains ongoing. Under Nigerian law, cannabis possession carries a minimum sentence of four years in prison, while drug trafficking can carry life imprisonment.

Khiree is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram; Reuters; USA Today; ThisDay.

title: Beyond the 956: American basketball player Greene Da'monte Khiree arrested in Nigeria after 75 pounds of cannabis allegedly found in suitcases
